# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `kindtui --cheatsheet`. Do not edit by hand; run `make docs`. -->

Every kindtui action, its key, its `:` command, and the shell command it is equivalent to. Inside kindtui, press `K` (or `:cmds`) for the same table filled in with the selected cluster and node, `y` to copy a command, and `ctrl-p` to search and run any action.

Placeholders: `<cluster>`, `<node>` (a node container such as `<cluster>-worker`), `docker` (or `podman`). `kubectl --context kind-<cluster>` works once `kind create` or `kind export kubeconfig` has written the context.

## Global

| Key | Command | Action | Equivalent shell command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `?` | `:help` | Help overlay with every key |  |
| `:` |  | Command line (tab completes commands and node names) |  |
| `ctrl-p` | `:palette` | Search every action by name and run it |  |
| `K` | `:cmds` | Command reference: every action with its equivalent shell command |  |
| `/` | `:filter TEXT` | Filter clusters by name or status | `kind get clusters \| grep TEXT` |
| `ctrl-r` `R` | `:refresh` | Refresh clusters and node detail now | `docker ps -a --filter label=io.x-k8s.kind.cluster` |
| `n` | `:create` | Create a cluster | `kind create cluster --name NAME --config FILE --wait 180s` |
| `o` | `:k9s` | Open k9s on the selected cluster | `k9s --context kind-<cluster>` |
| `c` | `:context` | Make kind-<cluster> the current kubectl context | `kind export kubeconfig --name <cluster> && kubectl config use-context kind-<cluster>` |
| `I` | `:info` | Tool paths and versions | `docker version && kind version && kubectl version --client` |
| `C` | `:runtime` | Start Colima or the Podman machine when the runtime is down | `colima start` |
| `q` | `:quit` | Quit kindtui |  |

## Clusters pane

| Key | Command | Action | Equivalent shell command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enter` `right` | `:nodes [CLUSTER]` | Open the nodes of the cluster | `kubectl --context kind-<cluster> get nodes -o wide` |
|  | `:cluster NAME` | Select a cluster by name | `kind get clusters` |
| `s` | `:start` | Start every node, control plane first | `docker start <cluster>-control-plane <cluster>-worker …` |
| `x` | `:stop` | Stop every node, workers first (asks first) | `docker stop <cluster>-worker … <cluster>-control-plane` |
| `r` | `:restart` | Stop, then start every node (asks first) | `docker stop <cluster>-worker … <cluster>-control-plane && docker start <cluster>-control-plane <cluster>-worker …` |
| `ctrl-d` `D` | `:delete` | Delete the cluster (type its name to confirm) | `kind delete cluster --name <cluster>` |
| `i` | `:image [IMAGE]` | Load a local image onto every node | `kind load docker-image IMAGE --name <cluster>` |
| `e` | `:export` | Export node logs to ~/kind-logs/<cluster>-<time> | `kind export logs --name <cluster> ~/kind-logs/<cluster>-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)` |

## Nodes pane

| Key | Command | Action | Equivalent shell command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enter` `s` | `:shell [NODE]` | Log in to the node as root (bash, or sh) | `docker exec -it <node> bash -l` |
| `l` | `:logs [NODE]` | Follow the node container log | `docker logs -f --tail 300 <node>` |
| `b` | `:kubelet [NODE]` | Follow the kubelet journal inside the node | `docker exec <node> journalctl -u kubelet -f -n 300` |
| `J` | `:containerd [NODE]` | Follow the containerd journal inside the node | `docker exec <node> journalctl -u containerd -f -n 300` |
|  | `:journal UNIT [NODE]` | Follow any systemd unit's journal inside the node | `docker exec <node> journalctl -u UNIT -f -n 300` |
| `d` | `:describe [NODE]` | kubectl describe node | `kubectl --context kind-<cluster> describe node <node>` |
| `p` | `:pods [NODE]` | Pods scheduled on the node | `kubectl --context kind-<cluster> get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>` |
| `u` | `:node-start [NODE]` | Start this node container | `docker start <node>` |
| `x` | `:node-stop [NODE]` | Stop this node container (asks first) | `docker stop <node>` |
| `r` | `:node-restart [NODE]` | Restart this node container (asks first) | `docker restart <node>` |
| `esc` `left` `h` `backspace` | `:clusters` | Back to the clusters pane |  |

## Navigation

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `tab` | Switch between the clusters and nodes panes |
| `↑ ↓ / k j` | Move |
| `pgup pgdn` | Move 10 rows |
| `g G / home end` | First / last row |
| `mouse` | Click selects, double-click opens nodes or logs in, wheel scrolls |
